name: Subby's Plushies & Essentials
notes: Based on the confirmed-working v3.9.67 main userscript; retains its original bootstrap/runtime layout.
Adds a built-in Edit Glow Layer X/Y panel via Essentials > Wardrobe > Heartkeeper's Lantern.
Glow has direct X/Y inputs and ±1/5/10 nudges, Light up/Extinguish, guide outline, Copy X/Y, Reset and Exit.
Preserves all existing lantern placement, priority 26 and previous glow offset storage; no new native BC asset/color layer.
